raw_segments.text: The captain ran across the passage to the landlady, where their cooking was done.
Not to lose precious time, Kalia in desperate haste shouted to Perezven, dead, and the dog
immediately turned round and lay on his back with its forepaws in the air.
Elisha looked on with the same suffering smile, but the person most delighted with the dog's
She laughed at the dog and began snapping her fingers and calling it, Perezven, Perezven.
